items.source: definition - the bean definition to build a bean name for
items.translation: definition - 用于构建 Bean 名称的 Bean 定义

items.source: the default bean name (never null)
items.translation: 默认 Bean 名称（永远不为null）

items.source: The default implementation delegates to buildDefaultBeanName(BeanDefinition).
items.translation: 默认实现委托给buildDefaultBeanName(BeanDefinition)。

items.source: Also supports JSR-330's Named annotation if available. Note that Spring component annotations always override such standard annotations.
items.translation: 同时也支持可用的 JSR-330 的 `Named` 注解。请注意，Spring 组件注解始终会覆盖此类标准注解。

items.source:
If the annotation's value doesn't indicate a bean name, an appropriate
name will be built based on the short name of the class (with the first
letter lower-cased), unless the first two letters are uppercase. For example:
items.translation: 如果注解的值未指示 Bean 名称，则将根据类的短名称（首字母小写）构建适当的名称，除非前两个字母均为大写。例如：

items.source:
The default implementation simply builds a decapitalized version
of the short class name: for example, "mypackage.MyJdbcDao" → "myJdbcDao".
items.translation: 默认实现仅构建短类名的去首字母大写版本：例如，"mypackage.MyJdbcDao" → "myJdbcDao"。

items.source:
Note that inner classes will thus have names of the form
"outerClassName.InnerClassName", which because of the period in the
name may be an issue if you are autowiring by name.
items.translation: 注意，内部类的名称将采用“outerClassName.InnerClassName”的形式，由于名称中包含点号，这可能会影响按名称进行自动线束（autowiring）的操作。

items.source: Description copied from interface: BeanNameGenerator
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：BeanNameGenerator

items.source: A convenient constant for a default AnnotationBeanNameGenerator instance, as used for component scanning purposes.
items.translation: 用于组件扫描目的的默认 AnnotationBeanNameGenerator 实例的便捷常量。

items.source: Check whether the given annotation is a stereotype that is allowed to suggest a component name through its value() attribute.
items.translation: 检查给定的注解是否是一个允许通过其 `value()` 属性建议组件名称的立体注解。

items.source: Derive a default bean name from the given bean definition.
items.translation: 从给定的 Bean 定义派生默认 Bean 名称。

items.source: Derive a bean name from one of the annotations on the class.
items.translation: 从类上的一个注解派生出一个 Bean 名称。

items.source: Generate a bean name for the given bean definition.
items.translation: 为给定的 Bean 定义生成一个 Bean 名称。

items.translation: 该注解是否带有组件名称的立体标记。
